title: P&ID validation and P&ID-to-3D consistency rules
note: Rule names from Autodesk Plant 3D / P&ID help (search extracts, grade B for wording); llull codes are this pack's design

pidRules.definition: a process line end connects to no component/nozzle/line and carries no end-of-line symbol (vent, drain, blind flange, off-page connector)
an inline component or equipment connection point not attached to a line although it appears to be; every attachment point of an inline component must be connected
an equipment nozzle without a line; access nozzles (manholes) and nozzles marked spare are reported as info

pidRules.plant3d: Unconnected Components (tanks / vessels must connect to at least one line)
pidRules.definition: a tank or vessel with no connected line
nominal size of an inline component differs from the line size at its connection point, with no reducer between
piping class of an inline component differs from its line segment (no spec break marked)
two connected segments with opposed flow directions, or a check valve against the segment flow direction
an off-page connector without a partner connector on another sheet of the project
two items share one full tag in the project tag registry

DEXPI segment internal violation: items in a segment are not a single chain from SourceItem to TargetItem (pyDEXPI INTERNAL_VIOLATION / CONNECTION_CONVENTION_VIOLATION / MULTIPLE_NODE_REFERENCE_VIOLATION)
an operated / control valve not referenced by an actuating system, or an actuating system with no controlling instrument function
a safety / relief valve without SetPressureHigh; reviewRequired because it is a pressure-protection device
a piping network system without a line number

pid3dRules.plant3d: P&ID item not placed in the 3D model (Validate: P&ID-to-3D)
pid3dRules.definition: a P&ID equipment, inline component or line with a tag but no 3D object with that tag
a tagged 3D equipment / pipe line / valve without a P&ID counterpart
nominal size differs between the P&ID item and its 3D counterpart
piping class differs between P&ID line and 3D line
the from/to ends (equipment tag + nozzle, or line) of a line differ between P&ID and 3D
item type differs (e.g. P&ID GlobeValve, 3D BallValve)
inline components along a line appear in a different order in 3D than on the P&ID
